Pocket lighter.d: Butane lighter with a roller mechanism, patented 1956 and in mass production from 1957.
Soft-flame gas lighter in the line that followed the Ligne 1 of the 1960s, designed with jeweller Jean Dinh Van; makes the 'cling' on opening.

note: added Dunhill Rollagas and S.T. Dupont Ligne 2 (Pipes Magazine via Firecrawl; Cigars International via Firecrawl). Unique, Maxijet etc. not found on a fetched page.
